title: Austin's Next Transit Move: Project Connect
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   **Big Transit Vote:** The City Council will vote on officially adopting the "Project Connect" system plan, a massive public transit expansion for Austin.
*   **Reshaping Mobility:** This plan outlines proposed new rail and bus lines designed to transform how people get around the city.
*   **Funding the Future:** Discussions will cover the proposed governance structure and financial strategy for Project Connect, detailing how this large-scale project would be funded.
*   **Virtual Public Input:** Due to COVID-19, residents could participate and offer comments on this crucial transit decision by registering to speak via telephone.

Speaker Registration for the June 10, 2020 
Joint Meeting of the Austin City Council and Capital Metro Board of Directors 
 
• 
The City Council and Capital Metro Board of Directors will each consider their own item. All 
public comment for both agency’s action will be taken at the beginning of the meeting (12:00 
p.m. on June 10, 2020). 
o The agenda and materials will be posted on both the City Council and Capital Metro 
Board websites. 
• 
People may register to speak or not speak, and may take the positions of in favor, against or 
neutral. 
• 
Due to COVID-19 and to maintain social distancing, public comment will be allowed via 
telephone; no in-person input will be allowed.

All speakers must register in advance of the meeting. Registration will open when the agenda 
posts on Friday, June 5, 2020, and will close at 12:00 p.m. on Tuesday, June 9, 2020.
